name: Triage the 71-file dirty working tree in codx-junior-platform
description:
Context: `repository_status` on branch `main` shows a heavily dirty tree: 4 staged files (GlobalSettings.vue, client/tests/effortsApi.test.mjs, codx-junior-installer/demo/ENVIRONMENT.md, docs/delivery-contract.md) plus ~71 unstaged files with ~22.6k insertions — mixing the efforts feature, .codx task JSON churn and generated/untracked task cards. Branch is ahead 2 of origin.

Goal: reduce this to a reviewable state without losing work.

Steps:
1. Cluster the change set: (a) efforts feature code + client + tests, (b) `.codx` task/session churn (generated data, probably gitignored or committed separately), (c) docs, (d) installer/demo.
2. For each cluster decide: commit (with a proper 50/72 message), gitignore, or discard.
3. Never `git restore` the efforts cluster; it is unvalidated work that must be preserved.

Acceptance: `git status --short` shows only known/ignored churn, every remaining change belongs to a named cluster, and the effort feature is either committed or explicitly parked on a card with its validation status.

## Triage result — the tree is not 71 random files, it is 5 coherent changes + noise + a locked index

Measured this shift with `project_changes` / `repository_overview` (git, not the atlas — the atlas tools are timing out, see `d8534b12`).

### State
- branch `main`, **ahead 5**, behind 0, dirty.
- **`locked: true`**, lock path `.git/index.lock` — until this lock is removed (or the run holding it ends) **no commit can be created**, which is why this card and `88d57bdd` keep looking stuck. Verify it is stale (`ps` for git) before deleting.
- 3 worktrees: `main`, `codx-junior-task-archive` (branch `codx-junior/task-archive`), `review-7b1a535` (detached). The detached review worktree is abandoned state and should be pruned.

### Cluster A — effort/recurrence policy (api, one logical change)
`ai/smol/constants.py` (+21/-6) · `ai/smol/effort.py` (+16/-8) · `ai/smol/smol_agent.py` (+135/-0) · `efforts/effort_manager.py` (+35/-4) · `model/effort.py` (+439/-7) · `autonomy/service.py` (+120/-0) · `tools/schedule_task_tool.py` (+53/-1) · `tools/project_manager_tools.py` (+118/-0, **recurrence only**) · `runtime.py` (+1) · `api/chat.py` (+107/-0) · `app.py` (+13/-1) · `global_settings.py` (+140/-1) · `db.py` (+27/-0) · `model/model.py` (+13/-1) · `.codx/efforts/{agile,default,max}/*.effort`
Tests in the same cluster: `tests/test_effort.py`, `tests/test_effort_manager.py`, `tests/test_recurrence_rearm.py`, `tests/test_constants.py`.
→ This is the work behind `73d89c91`; it is **self-contained and testable**. Commit it as one unit once the index is unlocked.

### Cluster B — CISO vault/secrets (api, review-gated)
`api/secrets.py` (+212/-46) · `security/ciso/{vault +374/-66, models +46, policy +16, secrets +38}` · `security/user_management.py` (+16/-3) · `tools/ciso_tools.py` (+134/-0) · `docs/design/secrets-resolver.md` · `tests/security/test_secrets_prompt.py` (new) · `tests/security/test_secrets_vault.py` (+134/-4)
→ **Do not bundle with Cluster A.** Touches credential handling, so it needs its own review and its own commit; it is the reason `88d57bdd` exists.

### Cluster C — repo-level staged UI/docs (outside `api/`)
`client/src/components/browsers/CoworkingVolume{Explorer,Mappings}.vue` (new) · `client/src/components/chat/ChatFindBar.vue` (new) · `client/src/utils/chatFind.js` (new) · `client/src/views/GlobalSettings.vue` · `client/package.json` · `client/tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` (new) · `wiki/{conftest.py,pytest.ini,requirements-dev.txt,tests/test_server.py}` (new) · `docs/delivery-contract.md` · `codx-junior-installer/demo/ENVIRONMENT.md` (new) · `.gitignore`
→ Independent of A and B; ready to commit as-is if the client tests pass.

### Noise — never commit
`.codx/tasks/**` card JSON (mine and other actors') · `.codx/browser_scripts/**` · `.codx/autonomy/state.json` · `.codx/harness/audit.jsonl`, `harness/audit.jsonl`, `api/harness/audit.jsonl` · `api/.codx/tasks/boards/*/board.json` · `pytest-qa-report.xml` (untracked artefact) · `api/scripts/dockerhub_publish.sh` (harmless, but unrelated to A/B/C — park it).
`.gitignore` already lists some of these; the fact they still show as modified means the ignore rules were added after the files were tracked.

### Proposed commit order (once `.git/index.lock` is clear)
1. Cluster C (no Python risk) → 2. Cluster A + its 4 tests → 3. Cluster B after review → 4. `.gitignore` + `git rm --cached` the noise files, in its own commit.

### Acceptance
`git status --porcelain` after step 4 shows **zero** `.codx/tasks/**`, `**/audit.jsonl` and `pytest-qa-report.xml` entries, and each of the four commits builds/passes its own tests. Nothing force-pushed; `main` stays local until a human pushes (`ahead 5` today).
